scope: This M2 repair pass and actual running/film checks are verified. A universal final art-quality or original-library-grade claim is not made.
renderer: 76 native SDF rock meshes; H/V/A and MC-normal CPU base reflectance; live raster lighting/shadows; real planar water reflection; procedural curved foliage and continuous woody geometry
sceneAssets: Code-generated geometry and runtime leaf/bark textures; no authored image/model/HDR scene assets; no QA binary cache in either final entry.
sourceRole: Creative and technical reference; not a visual-similarity or shader-reuse acceptance benchmark.

visualScope.intent: Clear, calm artistic Li River with coherent depth, complete mountain reflections and usable near driving views.
repairs: No noise-isoline rings or graph-paper rock bands
Continuous tapered trunks and branches with metre-scaled bark
Matched alluvial surfaces and low substrate close patch gaps
remainingStyleLimits: Some large rock surfaces remain sculpted and soft
Crown and spreading root families retain procedural repetition
The ultimate visual-quality judgment remains open for the user; functional checks do not replace it
visualScope.reviewNote: Representative actual images were reviewed independently. No universal every-view or photographic-realism claim.

bridgeSessionObservations.scope: QA reads only each bridge health endpoint and never calls session endpoints. Session activity is externally controlled; a before/after change cannot be attributed to this QA and does not establish whether the user used a page.

preservation.launcherIncident: An initial direct packaged-exe launch opened the ordinary hub, was stopped by exact own-PID identity, and was disclosed. All subsequent acceptance used a guarded explicit hidden QA dispatch.
